question: Which manager held the most Microsoft shares directly in 2026 Q1?
reference_sql: SELECT f.fund_name, list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE h.cusip = '594918104' AND h.report_quarter = '2026Q1' AND h.put_call IS NULL GROUP BY f.fund_name ORDER BY sum(h.ssh_prnamt) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many managers in the roster reported holding Tesla call options in 2026 Q1?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.fund_name), list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE h.cusip = '88160R101' AND h.report_quarter = '2026Q1' AND upper(h.put_call) = 'CALL'

question: What was the total value of Point72 Asset Management's put options in 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(h.value), list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE f.fund_name = 'Point72 Asset Management L.P.' AND h.report_quarter = '2026Q2' AND upper(h.put_call) = 'PUT'

question: Did Lone Pine Capital hold Amazon shares in 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(h.cusip) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END, list(DISTINCT f.accession_number) FROM filings f LEFT JOIN holdings h ON h.accession_number = f.accession_number AND h.cusip = '023135106' AND h.put_call IS NULL WHERE f.fund_name = 'Lone Pine Capital LLC' AND f.report_quarter = '2026Q2'

question: Which managers held Alphabet Class A shares directly in both 2026 Q1 and 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT f.fund_name, list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE h.cusip = '02079K305' AND h.put_call IS NULL GROUP BY f.fund_name HAVING count(DISTINCT h.report_quarter) = 2 ORDER BY f.fund_name

question: How many filings in the dataset are 13F notices?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*), list(DISTINCT accession_number) FROM filings WHERE form_type LIKE '13F-NT%'

question: What was Elliott Investment Management's largest position by value in 2026 Q2?
note: The issuer of the largest direct position.
reference_sql: SELECT any_value(h.name_of_issuer), list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE f.fund_name = 'Elliott Investment Management L.P.' AND h.report_quarter = '2026Q2' AND h.put_call IS NULL GROUP BY h.cusip ORDER BY sum(h.value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: By how many shares did Citadel Advisors LLC's direct Apple holding change from 2026 Q1 to 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN h.report_quarter = '2026Q2' THEN h.ssh_prnamt ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN h.report_quarter = '2026Q1' THEN h.ssh_prnamt ELSE 0 END), list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE f.fund_name = 'Citadel Advisors LLC' AND h.cusip = '037833100' AND h.put_call IS NULL

question: Which manager reported the highest total portfolio value in 2026 Q1?
reference_sql: SELECT f.fund_name, list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE h.report_quarter = '2026Q1' GROUP BY f.fund_name ORDER BY sum(h.value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct CUSIPs did Tiger Global Management report in 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.cusip), list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE f.fund_name = 'Tiger Global Management LLC' AND h.report_quarter = '2026Q2'

question: Did Starboard Value hold any put options in 2026 Q2?
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(h.cusip) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END, list(DISTINCT f.accession_number) FROM filings f LEFT JOIN holdings h ON h.accession_number = f.accession_number AND upper(h.put_call) = 'PUT' WHERE f.fund_name = 'Starboard Value LP' AND f.report_quarter = '2026Q2'

question: What was the combined value of Nvidia shares held directly by all roster managers in 2026 Q1?
